title: Why the 1992 Sega CD Was a Game‑Changing Add‑On

scenes.text: 1992 saw Sega add a CD player to its Mega‑Drive – why?
It introduced full‑motion video, something no cartridge could store.
scenes.label: FULL‑MOTION VIDEO
scenes.query: Sega CD full motion video capability

scenes.text: The disc could hold up to 650 MB, far more than the 4 MB cartridge limit.
scenes.label: 650 MB DISCS

scenes.text: It added a second audio channel, giving games CD‑quality music.
scenes.label: SECOND AUDIO CHANNEL

scenes.text: Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.

description: The Sega CD turned the Mega‑Drive into a multimedia machine, paving the way for modern game audio and video. Stay tuned for more hidden hardware stories.
